environment_observed.note: Observed during project experiments; per-run raw JSON host fields retained where available. 0 means no explicit Docker per-container limit, not fixed resource usage.

measurement_notes.kafka: Parallel Kafka workers measured first-to-last processed event while the producer was sending. Includes producer waiting/backpressure; excludes startup.
measurement_notes.flink: Flink reads a pre-filled bounded Kafka topic. active_seconds is first parse record to last window output; startup excluded. Python CPU/RSS excludes JVM.
measurement_notes.comparison: Do not treat Kafka pipeline and Flink consumer-only figures as directly comparable end-to-end throughput.
